verified: The US has installed more than 200 GWh of battery storage, according to a report cited by Electrek and covered by SEIA, which puts additions at 48.3 GWh in the first nine months of 2026 — up 20% year over year — with Texas leading utility-scale deployment at 12.3 GWh, followed by Arizona (7.7 GWh) and California (6.8 GWh).
unconfirmed: The sources give no exact cumulative total beyond "more than 200 GWh," do not break out how much of the figure is utility-scale versus residential or commercial storage, and do not detail the underlying project list or the specific numbers in the revised forecast; the article's own excerpt supplies only the headline total and the roughly 50 GWh of 2026 additions.

verified: Electrek 报道称，美国已安装超过 200 GWh 电池储能，其中 2026 年前九个月新增 48.3 GWh；美国储能协会（SEIA）发布的报告称，同期全美装机同比增长 20%，得克萨斯州以 12.3 GWh 的公用事业规模新增装机居首，亚利桑那州和加利福尼亚州分别为 7.7 GWh 和 6.8 GWh。
unconfirmed: 200 GWh 的统计范围，即是否包含住宅与表后储能、只统计公用事业规模还是全部计入，以及各州分项数字，均出自 SEIA 这份行业报告，未见独立第三方核验；Electrek 标题所承诺的“分布在哪里”，在可见正文中并未展开，具体项目清单与并网时间也无法从现有内容确认。

titles.en: US battery storage passes 200 GWh, with ~50 GWh added in 2026 so far, Electrek reports
